question: Which office of a union may connect, replace and remove its public social media accounts and hold their credentials, who may publish, schedule and delete a post in the union name and what approval, classification and member-consent check precedes publication, which analytics may members read, and how must the platform credentials be held and revoked?
decision: Disable social account connections, publishing and scheduling in pilot/production until existing plaintext tokens are secured or revoked, secrets move to controlled custody (Key Vault), per-org delegation and sender approval are enforced, scheduling works at actual send time, and token revocation is proven. Thereafter only designated org admins connect accounts and approved communications officers publish under dual-control; never export member data into posts without separate authority.
originalProposedDecision: Only admins connect or remove accounts. Officers publish, with a second approver by default (org-configurable). Credentials in Key Vault, revoked on removal. Scheduled posts publish at their time. No member data in posts.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
